newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks end down, politics softens sentiment.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks end down, politics softens sentiment.

text.p: Thai stocks lost ground on Thursday afternoon as sentiment continued to soften as negotiations between coalition partners over key economic cabinet appointments showed no signs of progress, brokers said.

"Given that it looks like we are not going to get the best case scenario, it's more a question of whether we will have to settle for second, third or fourth best," said Rob Collins, head of research at Asia Equity.
The SET closed at 955.35, down 11.08 points, or 1.15 percent, on trade worth 3.814 billion baht. The SET-50 closed down 1.13 points to 73.17.
